resources.string: %1$s\n\nRestore all domain content from this retained revision, including objective, context, workload inputs, primary model and optional-tier configuration? This immediately saves a new RESTORE revision and retains earlier history. Current saved title, sample pins and other metadata stay unchanged. Unsaved objective/context/workload edits will be replaced on successful acknowledgement; unsaved title/sample edits remain in the editor and still need Save locally. Failure keeps visible edits. No report, price or compatibility result is restored or re-evaluated.
